review.notes: Approved after full-resolution image review. The rich four-panel plate preserves a correct top-view pJJ with the weak link and B_parallel=B_x along x, upper/lower bank phases +phi/2 and -phi/2, and two endpoint MZMs. It cleanly separates two disconnected finite segments with exactly gamma_1 through gamma_4 and fixed-even-parity logical basis states; shows a device-specific class-D bulk gap closing/reopening with nu:0 to 1 and explicitly rejects a universal nanowire criterion; and distinguishes invasive end tunneling from non-invasive dispersive spectroscopy while stating that ZBPs, re-entrance, microwave gap reopening, and end correlations are signatures rather than proof. Minor ancillary duplications around gate/weak-link callouts do not alter the scientific story.
